BearerAuth.description: Paste Bearer token without "Bearer" prefix (e.g. eyJ1c2VySWQiOjIsImVtYWlsI...)

get.description: Fetch Stripe publishable key and currency for client SDK initialization.

post.description: Authenticates credentials and yields JWT access token.

timezone.description: Optional user device/preferred IANA timezone to update profile

post.description: Selects the user's role and provider type after registration.
Authenticates a user via Google or iOS social credentials. Auto-creates account if the social key does not exist.

400.description: Missing fields or invalid social type

post.description: Generates a 6-digit password reset verification code and sends it via Twilio SMS to the user's verified phone number.

400.description: Invalid input or account lacks a verified phone number

post.description: Verifies the 6-digit verification code sent to the email address. Yields a short-lived reset token.

200.description: OTP verified successfully. Yields password reset token.

post.description: Resets the account password using the verified password reset token.
Allows an authenticated user to change their account password.

patch.summary: Update user profile / timezone (Common for Client & Provider)
patch.description: Updates the authenticated user's profile info (e.g. timezone) and returns updated token and user object (same response format as login API).

200.description: User updated successfully. Same structure as login response.

get.description: Returns profile details based on authenticated Bearer token. Accessible only for clients.

delete.description: Allows an authenticated client to permanently delete their own account and all associated profile, services, and amenities data.

put.description: Update client profile details. Accessible only for clients.

get.description: Returns provider profile details based on authenticated Bearer token. Accessible only for providers.

delete.description: Allows an authenticated provider to permanently delete their own account and all associated profile, services, and amenities data.

post.description: Updates the provider profile experience field. Accessible only for providers.

get.description: Fetch list of all notifications for the authenticated provider. Includes bookingId, clientId, providerId in top-level object and in data payload for deep-link routing.

message.example: Sarah Connor has booked an appointment.

get.description: Fetch list of all notifications for the authenticated client. Includes bookingId, clientId, providerId in top-level object and in data payload for deep-link routing.

post.summary: Set Provider Working Hours & Slot Duration
post.description: Allows a provider to set their default working hours and slot duration (in minutes).

get.summary: Get Provider Availability Slots (Monday to Sunday)
get.description: Generates time slots according to the configuration and returns status (active or inactive) for Monday through Sunday.

post.description: Allows provider to select/pick which slots they are active or inactive for.

get.summary: Get Provider Available Slots for Specific Date
get.description: Returns only the available (non-booked, active) slots for a provider on a specific date.

parameters.name: timezone
parameters.description: IANA timezone identifier (e.g. Asia/Kolkata). If omitted, defaults to logged-in user timezone from Bearer token.

providerId.description: Provider ID to evaluate provider rush mode pricing if active

stripe_transection_id.description: Stripe transaction or payment intent ID

stripe_transection_raw.description: Raw Stripe transaction response object store
